module_title: MS PowerPoint - Foundational Basics and Slide Interface
introduction: In the 'Computer Knowledge' section of SSC CGL, MS PowerPoint is the premier 'Presentation' software. It is used to visually present information using text, graphics, and media. At this foundational level, we focus on understanding the basic interface, slide mechanics, and essential keyboard shortcuts.

core_concepts.title: Slide vs. Presentation
core_concepts.description: Just as MS Word uses 'Pages', PowerPoint uses 'Slides'. A single file containing a collection of these slides is officially called a 'Presentation'.

core_concepts.title: Default Settings
core_concepts.description: When you open a new PowerPoint file, the default file name is 'Presentation1'. The very first slide that appears by default is called the 'Title Slide'.

core_concepts.title: Inserting a New Slide
core_concepts.description: To insert a brand new slide into your current presentation, the shortcut is `Ctrl + M`.

core_concepts.title: Starting a Slide Show
core_concepts.description: To launch your presentation in full-screen mode for an audience, press the `F5` key. This will ALWAYS start the slide show from the very first slide (Beginning).

important_entities.name: File Extension
important_entities.significance: From PowerPoint 2007 onwards, the default file extension is `.pptx` (prior to 2003, it was `.ppt`).

important_entities.name: Placeholders
important_entities.significance: The empty boxes with dotted borders that appear on a new slide (prompting you to 'Click to add text' or insert a picture) are officially called Placeholders.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: This is the most frequently tested shortcut trap in PowerPoint. Aspirants assume `Ctrl + N` creates a new slide. Wrong! `Ctrl + N` opens a completely New File (Presentation). To add a new slide to your EXISTING file, you must use `Ctrl + M`.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Associate the F5 function key with presenting your slides in Full-screen mode to the audience.

exam_strategy_tips: Tier-1 exams directly ask: 'What is the default name of a file created in PowerPoint?' Always choose 'Presentation1'.
